description: Register ONE NEW web address through Soclo. First use soclo_domain_quote and show the owner its exact price. BUYING SPENDS CREDITS — real money that cannot be refunded — so it requires confirm: true AND expected_credits copied from the "quote" the owner approved: this tool re-quotes, refuses before sending anything if the price moved, buying is switched off or the balance is short, and re-checks after a 409 to tell you whether the address is ALREADY YOURS rather than sending you off to buy a different name. If the registry still needs registrant details, the refusal names them — pass them in "contact" and quote again. A 5xx or a lost connection on buy is an UNKNOWN outcome, not a clean refusal: reconcile with "list" before retrying.

confirm.description: For "buy": true after owner approval of exact hostname and price. For "disconnect": true after approval of the exact connected hostname. Without confirmation these actions send nothing.

contact.description: For "buy": the registrant details the registry requires — name, email, phone, street, city, postal_code, country_code. Name, email and phone are prefilled from the Brand Kit; street, city and postal_code never are. Pass the ones the refusal named in missingFields.

expected_credits.description: For "buy": the credits figure from the "quote" the owner approved. If the live price differs the buy is refused before anything is sent.

name: soclo_domain_buy
title: Buy a quoted web address
